comment: Pages where lamina's page_texts and pdf.js or pdftotext disagree after whitespace and bidi controls are removed (crates/laminapdf/tests/text_differential.rs, todo B9c), each with the reason. Every entry must still disagree.

exceptions.reason: the only text is the signature widget's appearance stream; pdftotext extracts annotation appearances, lamina (like pdf.js's getTextContent) extracts the page content only
the only text is the signature widget's appearance stream; pdftotext extracts annotation appearances, lamina (like pdf.js's getTextContent) extracts the page content only

pdftotext writes right-to-left text as displayed: phrases in visual order (the Arabic and Hebrew lines' words come out reversed), lamina in logical order; the same behaviour fixtures/text/extraction-exceptions.json records, https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/poppler/poppler/-/blob/poppler-26.10.0/poppler/TextOutputDev.cc
